selection: Approximately twenty genuinely new families; current live execution matrix. Bounded acceptance does not establish unrestricted conformance. Infrastructure and existing support excluded.

features.name: Raw/multiline string templates and standard multiline expression/navigation parsing
features.acceptance_boundary: UTF-16, raw escapes, line normalization, nested interpolation, newline grammar; original AudioHttpErrorBody and raw-literal tests. Multi-dollar interpolation remains outside the initial boundary.
restrictions: Raw/multiline strings and bounded newline grammar; multi-dollar/annotated suffix/Unicode unbraced/Nothing templates remain explicit boundaries.

features.name: Source generic classifiers, parameterized inheritance and erased override bridges
features.acceptance_boundary: AlphanumComparator; bounds, substitution, variance, Java dispatch, signatures and Kotlin metadata. Existing generic functions do not count.
features.execution: Implementation and validation in isolated source copy; not counted as accepted.

features.name: Independent accessor visibility and internal property contracts
features.acceptance_boundary: BackForwardList; private setters, inaccessible callers, internal JVM names, friend and nonfriend consumers.

features.name: JVM overload generation for default arguments
features.acceptance_boundary: FormattedVerseText and SongInfo; top-level/member/object/companion/constructor overloads, masks, effects, collisions and annotations.
restrictions: Function overload lowering; constructors/extensions/source interfaces/qualified object markers remain explicit boundaries; failing app probes retained.

features.name: Remaining signed primitive/array representations
features.acceptance_boundary: Short and Long/Boolean/Float/Double arrays; allocation, indexed read/write, iteration, vararg/spread, boxing and Java ABI. AudioHighlightColor needs real Android dependencies.
features.execution: Implementation and validation in isolated source copy; not counted as accepted.

features.name: Class-reference expressions and bounded KClass/Class interoperability
features.acceptance_boundary: Primitive/reference/array literals, nullable expression checks and ordinary .java resolution; no full reflection.
features.execution: Scope assessment and implementation in isolated source copy; not counted as accepted.

features.name: Single-field value-class JVM ABI
features.acceptance_boundary: Gid and Rpp; reference/primitive representation, nullable/generic/interface boxing, mangling and official Kotlin/Java consumers. Experimental multi-field values excluded.

features.name: Sealed hierarchies and exhaustive when
features.acceptance_boundary: VersionFileImporter.Result and AudioBarCommand; exhaustiveness, nullable subjects, module restrictions and metadata.

features.name: Inner/local classes and captured state
features.acceptance_boundary: Actual AndroidBible inner adapters; outer receiver/capture identity, constructor ABI and lexical metadata. Existing nested classes/local functions excluded.

features.name: Class/interface delegation
features.acceptance_boundary: Ordinary interface forwarding, properties, override precedence, evaluation order and generic bridge boundaries. Existing delegated properties excluded.

features.name: Expanded object semantics
features.acceptance_boundary: Data objects, supported supertypes and object expressions; initialization, equality/hash/string behavior and metadata. Existing named singleton support excluded.

features.name: Expanded enum semantics
features.acceptance_boundary: Entry-specific subclasses, interface implementations and constructor defaults; initialization, dispatch, signatures and metadata. Existing enum bodies/arguments excluded.

features.name: Generic source aliases
features.acceptance_boundary: Substitution, bounds, visibility, cycles and exported metadata/Kotlin consumers. Existing nongeneric aliases excluded.
restrictions: Generic aliases in type positions; generic imported getter/alias constructors and two larger originals remain actual failing boundary rows, not passes.

features.name: Unsigned representations and operations
features.acceptance_boundary: Ordinary stdlib resolution through value-class ABI, arithmetic/comparison/conversion/boxing and array boundaries; no API-name substitutions.

features.name: Compile-time constant expressions and references
features.acceptance_boundary: VersionFileImporter MAX_FILE_SIZE and SongBookUtil MAX_RESPONSE_SIZE; overflow, types, dependency constants and annotation values. Existing literals excluded.
restrictions: Typed scalar expressions and source references; Byte/Short declarations, constexpr calls, floating-point string formatting and compiled Kotlin constant visibility remain unsupported. Evaluation/reference depth and JVM modified UTF-8 limits are explicit.
Proven absent bare source names are invalid; unresolved qualified/external names remain explicit unsupported lookup boundaries.

features.name: Remaining Java member resolution rules
features.acceptance_boundary: Static imports, inherited Object members and ordinary bean properties; visibility, ambiguity, nullability and annotation metadata. Existing direct fields/methods excluded.
restrictions: Bounded concrete Java synthetic properties and explicit static imports; mapped/interface/enum/Kotlin property and static wildcard/interface import boundaries remain explicit; Random app import fails.

features.name: Rich annotation values and source declarations
features.acceptance_boundary: Numeric/enum/class/array/nested values, defaults, retention/placement and Java reflection/Kotlin consumers. Existing three scalar annotation kinds excluded.

features.name: Member/companion extensions and extension properties
features.acceptance_boundary: Distinct dispatch and extension receivers, overload selection, accessors, captures and nullability. Existing top-level/library extensions excluded.

features.name: Source inline/reified semantics
features.acceptance_boundary: Supported reified tests/casts/class literals, noinline/crossinline, evaluation order and non-local-return boundaries. Existing compiled inline expansion excluded.

features.name: Suspend functions and suspend function types
features.acceptance_boundary: Real Continuation suspension/resumption, spilled state and exceptional completion; no synchronous shim or complete kotlinx.coroutines implementation.

limitations: The approximately twenty-family request is not complete. Unassessed entries are not implemented-feature claims.
Upstream adapter diagnostic-equivalence/helpers/mixed compilation/incremental execution remain separately explicit harness boundaries.
No new complete AndroidBible module, full app, device behavior or speedup is claimed.
